name: coding-agent-tools
description: Language-neutral tool surface shared by all harnesses. Paths are relative to the sandbox workspace root.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories under a relative path (default: workspace root).

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 text file in the workspace.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace the first occurrence of old_str with new_str in a file. Fails if old_str is missing or not unique.

old_str.description: Exact text to find (must appear exactly once).

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run the workspace test suite (python -m pytest -q). Use this to check whether the task is solved.
